# Jurnie for Codex

Connect Codex to your Jurnie account to review goals, plan your day, manage personal or shared tasks, track habits, set daily intentions, and schedule follow-through. The package includes the shared Jurnie workflow skill and a connection to Jurnie's OAuth-protected MCP server.

An existing Jurnie account is required. Free accounts can connect; existing product limits apply. The plugin offers no purchases. Sign in through Jurnie and choose only the access you need. Deletions need separate permission and confirmation. Calendar event creation requires a connected Google Calendar.

## Get started

[Public setup instructions](https://www.jurnie.co/help/mcp#codex)

Try: “Show my Jurnie tasks”, “Plan today from my Jurnie priorities”, or “Create a personal Jurnie task with no Journey called Review the launch checklist.” Confirm a write when your client asks. The assistant should report changes only after a successful tool response.

Jurnie cannot send email, process payments, or read Google Drive files. Your connection exposes only data accessible to your signed-in account, according to the scopes you grant. You can revoke access in Jurnie's settings.
